name: conjoint-companion-desktop
description: Offline desktop companion app for test-retest reliability workflows in metric conjoint experiments.

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:shiny && npm run check:rust && npm run check:audit
scripts.release:windows: node scripts/release_preflight.mjs windows && npm run check && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run smoke:runtime && npm run clean:release-output && tauri build --no-bundle && npm run export:portable
